b.sound: This widely popular book is a fantasy epic that tells the exciting adventures of a poor farm boy and his journey to knighthood.
This book follows the true story of Martin Luther King Jr, from his beginnings as a minister to his famous speech in Washington D.C.
This mystery novel follows a brilliant detective who is called to investigate a shocking murder at a grand country estate.
In this horror story, the main character gets lost while out walking and comes across a ghostly figure on a path deep in a dark, spooky forest.
This heartfelt romance novel tells the story of a young woman who discovers her grandmother’s old love letters and begins to uncover a decades-long secret about true love.
Set in the year 2089, this science fiction novel follows a young astronaut on a deep-space mission who must repair her ship after a sudden accident leaves her floating alone among the stars.

atoms.b: I just finished a ((romance)) book about two people who didn’t like each other at first but slowly started to fall in love. It was kind of sweet, although the ending was a little predictable for me. I guessed what was going to happen about halfway through the story. What kind of books do you like, Fatima?
That sounds nice, Jordan, but I prefer stories that are ((science_fiction)). If a book has robots or space travel, I’ll read it right away. What about you, Rhys?
I like ((mystery)) stories where you follow clues to solve a case. I always try to guess the answer before the detective does.

So we all like different things. But what kind of stories do you not like? As for me, I would never read a ((biography)). I know they follow real people, and you can learn something new, but I can’t focus when it’s all facts and no imagination. I prefer exciting adventures set in far away places.
I can’t stand ((fantasy)) stories. All those dragons and magic spells just don’t interest me. I’d rather read something that feels real.
I agree! That’s why I rarely pick up ((horror)) books. It’s not that I’m scared, I just don’t care for things like ghosts and vampires.
